state: Drive API v0.1.0 built at /api/ (pinned, latest, SRI, changelog, docs) with sign-in, list, search, download, export, upload, folder, move, trash. /app/ is built on it. Tested with mocks and in a browser against a mocked Google; not yet against real Google: no client configured.
waiting_on: Dinis: the app needs an External OAuth client (the Gmail tool's is Internal, so an outside team cannot use it). In Google Cloud add origin https://drive.google.tool.sovereignweb.site and redirect URI https://drive.google.tool.sovereignweb.site/app/connect/, scope drive.file only. Then say: 'a.drive, the client ID is <id>; commit it to site/app/config.js'. Exact values: /app/setup/

Dinis: to confirm the scope, say: 'a.drive, use drive.file'. Restricted scopes (drive, drive.readonly) need Google's verification and, for a public client, a paid security assessment: say 'a.drive, add drive.readonly and I take Google's review' only if you accept that. Trade-offs: /app/scopes/
Dinis: the Picker needs a browser API key and the project number in config.js; optional, the app works without it on files it creates.
Dinis: card image is still the seed's neutral one; say 'a.drive, make the share card' to replace it.
